evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce TRIAD, a benchmark for omni-modal ambiguity resolution.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each item is a text--image--audio triplet paired with a question and a set of answer options, and is constructed so that the full triplet determines a unique answer while removing any one modality makes the set of consistent options non-unique.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating $14$ omni-modal systems reveals that strong item-level performance does not translate into robust scene-level disambiguation: the best model still trails humans by over $20$ points in group accuracy.
